messages:
aj: Starting canary for quantize-v2 in us-east-1 now. 10% traffic split, routes /generate + /chat. Please watch p95 latency, 5xx, and any 429s on tokens API. I pushed rollout config: `canary=quantize-v2:2026-03-20-1103`
deploy-bot: Deployment started: quantize-v2:2026-03-20-1103 -> us-east-1 (canary 10%). CI checks passed. :rocket:
maria: copying dashboard links: https://console/redwood/slo/quantize-v2 and overlay for route:/embed and route:/tokens
sre-bot: Alert: spike detected for route:/embed -> 429 rate increased from 0.2% to 6.4% over 2m (p95 latency unchanged). Alert severity: warning. fingerprint: embed-429-2026-03-20-11:05
nick: seeing the same in logs, looks like token-throttle errors from the cache layer. Example trace: `embed/req/4578 -> token_bucket:exhausted`.
maria: any chance this is related to the new kv-cache changes in quantize-v2? that changed eviction timing.
leah: I can replicate locally with a stress script hitting /embed at ~200rps; gets 429s after a few seconds. Rolling back config for that route might be fastest.
aj: Options: 1) abort entire canary and rollback globally 2) pin just /embed to quantize-v1 via routing rule 3) increase bucket for cache (risky during canary). Thoughts?
maria: prefer #2 to avoid losing canary telemetry for other routes. We need to preserve the test for /generate and /chat.
sre-bot: New action suggestion: create a route override. Command: `/deploy route-pin --route /embed --target quantize-v1:stable --duration 60m --reason "embed 429 spike"` (dry-run shows success)
nick: ran the dry-run, looks good. Will apply if aj gives thumbs.
aj: applying route-pin now.
deploy-bot: Action: route-pin applied -> /embed -> quantize-v1:stable (expires in 60m). NOTE: traffic for /embed is now excluded from canary.
sre-bot: Alert update: embed 429 spike subsided to 0.6% within 40s after route-pin. p95 and 5xx stable. Marking incident as mitigated.
leah: great — can you capture a snapshot of logs and the failing traces for postmortem before we unpin? I'll open a short incident doc.
maria: opened doc: https://docs.internal/incidents/embed-429-2026-03-20 with initial notes and timeline. Adding eval prompts to reproduce.
aj: decision: keep canary running for other routes for another 20m, leave /embed pinned to quantize-v1 and collect diffs. If nothing else fails, we'll roll forward and then run a focused regression for kv-cache behavior.
nick: I pushed a temporary toggle to reduce cache eviction aggressiveness in a feature branch that should address the reproducible case. Will create a test build and retest in staging.
maria: postmortem owners: leah (sre), nick (engineer), aj (release lead). Adding action items: add route-level smoke checks to deploy gating, add automated rollback for route-specific 429s > 3% for 5m.
aj: thanks team. if anyone sees anything odd in the next 20m ping here. :eyes:
